name: Alpha-to-Weight Computation (Backward)
definition: Computes gradients of the loss with respect to alpha values given gradients of the loss with respect to weights and the final transmittance, using reverse accumulation.
summary: Alpha-to-Weight Computation (Backward) computes gradients of the loss with respect to per-sample alpha values using reverse accumulation, serving as the differentiable counterpart to the forward pass.
